description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseService class, which provides methods to access and modify employee license data via an EmployeeLicenseDao object. It is part of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin and serves as a service layer for employee license management.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee license data, providing getter and setter for the EmployeeLicenseDao object.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeLicenseDao instance, creating a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeLicenseDao instance to be used by this service.
